brief:
More than 340 children have been killed and hundreds more injured in Gaza over the past year despite a ceasefire agreement between Hamas and Israel, UN News reported Friday citing the UN Children's Fund.

UNICEF did not specify in the available reporting the circumstances surrounding the deaths or the parties responsible for the casualties during the period following the announced ceasefire accord.
dek: A little over one year since a ceasefire agreement was announced between Hamas fighters and Israel, more than 340 children have been reported killed and hundreds more injured, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Friday.
title: UNICEF reports 340 children killed in Gaza since ceasefire agreement
